title: Irrigation Process Migration Readiness and Smallest Structural Seam
readiness_questions: Can B1.10 irrigation decisions consume all required hydraulic information through an admitted process-facing read-only hydraulic view without HeadCalc or reference-Richards internal state?
Can irrigation persistent management state live inside the F-KT opaque physical transaction carrier so rejected trials cannot consume events, counters or quota?
Can surface irrigation and SSDI be delivered through explicit physical flux/source contracts and counted exactly once by authoritative interval mass accounting?
Can legacy file parsing and reporting state remain outside the process kernel seam?
Can the smallest structural seam preserve B1.10 event ordering and explicit calendar/day semantics without inventing a generic daily kernel assumption?

required_process_data_separation.reporting_only_history: outside committed physical process state unless proven continuation-critical

minimum_candidate_fields: committed node water content with source-bound semantics
active-node shape and node identity sufficient for sensor/root-zone selection
hydraulic_view_minimum_semantics.qualification_requirement: The view and its mapping from committed physical state must be qualified by the owning F-SI/runtime lineage before F-PM03 production irrigation migration.

transaction_requirements: Every continuation-critical irrigation cursor/counter must be cloned with the physical transaction state.
Rejected trials must not permanently increment day/event counters or advance fixed-event cursors.
Rollback/replay from the same committed revision must reproduce the same irrigation decision and flux result.
Transient qssdi/gird/nird/result workspace must not become duplicate committed water state.
mass_requirements: SSDI source contribution must be counted exactly once through authoritative accepted-interval accounting.
Surface irrigation reaching the soil top boundary must be counted exactly once as external top inflow.
Process diagnostics/reporting totals must never add a second authoritative mass contribution.
Rejected trials must not publish mass accounting.
time_requirements: Preserve fixed-date irrigation schedules and crop-year windows as explicit calendar management semantics.
Preserve minimum-day and weekly trigger counters where B1.10 semantics are genuinely day-count based.
Do not hide the legacy driver fact that Irrigation(3) is invoked at flDayStart.
Do not generalize irrigation to arbitrary interval durations until each trigger/event-duration rule has explicit source-bound semantics.
readiness_pass_conditions: Qualified process-facing hydraulic view is available on the exact source lineage selected for migration.
F-KT transaction carrier can include the proposed compact irrigation continuation state without bypassing checkpoint/candidate/commit semantics.
Authoritative mass path for the selected smallest irrigation seam is complete and non-duplicative.
No required irrigation physics depends on legacy file I/O inside the process seam.
No unqualified SNOW or other process change is required for the focused fixture.
production_change_policy: No src/process irrigation module, runtime irrigation state, solver binding or production irrigation source is added unless all readiness pass conditions are satisfied on one source-bound lineage.
snow_policy: Reuse exact already-qualified F-MR06/F-VQ17/F-MQ24 SNOW semantics only; F-PM03 does not reimplement or requalify SNOW.
